mentions.name: Yomu
mentions.description: Yomu is an indie iOS Japanese reader designed to make intermediate reading easier. It features adaptive, level-based furigana that hides readings for kanji the reader already knows, an offline dictionary built on JMDict, and custom tokenization logic using IPADic for accuracy. It is live on the App Store.
mentions.problem: While studying for JLPT N4, the author wanted furigana that adapts to known kanji so they could focus on real text without constant lookups.
mentions.audience: Intermediate Japanese learners, particularly those studying for JLPT exams who want to read real text without constant dictionary lookups.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on Yomu, an indie iOS Japanese reader intended to make intermediate reading easier.
